summary.text: Dan Knodl is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly from District 24 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Matt Brown.
He owns Reef Point Resort and has served on the Washington County Board.

paragraphs.text: Daniel Knodl graduated from Menomonee Falls East High School in 1977.
His career experience includes owning Reef Point Resort, and he has been affiliated with the Ozaukee/Washington Land Trust, the Pike Lake Sportsmans Club and the MF Optimist Club.
Knodl served on the Washington County Board.

Ballotpedia's election results show him winning Assembly District 24 general elections in 2018, 2020, 2022 and 2024, with a win over Democrat Jodi Habush Sinykin in the April 4, 2023 special general election for Wisconsin State Senate District 8 in between.
